senses.sense_definition: The state or quality of being likely to change or vary.

examples.text: The <w>variability</w> of the weather makes it difficult to plan outdoor events.
We must consider the <w>variability</w> in human behavior when designing this study.

senses.sense_definition: The extent to which data points differ from the average or from each other.

examples.text: High <w>variability</w> in the test scores suggests that the students had different levels of preparation.
The researchers analyzed the <w>variability</w> of the results to ensure the experiment was reliable.
